name: Someone talks over someone else
description: Needs --participants 3 or more. While two people speak at once the line is labelled with both names, joined by a semicolon, or falls back to Remote.

steps.text: So the main risk with this approach is that we cannot easily measure it.

overlap.text: We would have to compare the label against the audio clock for every single line.
Sorry to jump in, but the capture clock already gives us exactly that.

steps.text: As I was saying, the capture clock is the reference.
